description.zh: ? 一句话：按文档讲的是什么来找，不用记得原词。用你选的模型（“本地模型”插件或 Ollama，都在本机、不上传；或云服务的密钥）
description.en: ? a sentence: finds documents by what they are about, not by their words. Uses the model you pick (the Local models plugin or Ollama, on this PC with nothing uploaded; or a cloud service's key)

notes.zh: 闲着时 Windows 内存用到 70% 以上，只留下一小部分（比上次让出后多出 32 MB 以内，够每次查询读的索引用），其余让出；以前到 80% 就一点都不还，几百 MB 的数据会在内存最紧的时候一直占着（#500）。权限不变。
notes.en: While idle with 70 % or more of the memory in use, it keeps only a small working set (up to 32 MB over what stayed after the last time, enough for the index every query reads) and gives the rest back; from 80 % it used to give nothing back, holding hundreds of MB just when the memory was wanted (#500). Permissions unchanged.
